messages:
Lucy (Partnerships): Quick scrub after the mini dry-run with EdgeWorks + StratusNode. Found a couple last-mile items we should decide on before final publish.
Elena (Marketing): Thanks. High-level: landing + marketplace listing need matching hero, one-liner, three bullets, and marketplace SKU mapping. I have draft copy but need the final SKU IDs from Product.
Mark (Product): SKU mappings mostly set. One mismatch: Azure listing expected `rn-market-standard` but backend uses `rn-market-core`. Can we standardize or add alias?
Vikram (Engineering): We can add an alias layer in the catalog service quickly. Will push a migration tonight. Also saw StratusNode health-check failing intermittently on long-tail regions (ap-south). Debugging now.
Maya (EdgeWorks SI): On our side SSO handshake and schema mapping passed. However the webhook sample in the integration docs doesn't include the new tenant_id field—EdgeWorks needs it for provisioning. Can you update docs or add backward-compatible payload?
Kasia (Design): Marketplace hero and partner badge suggestions in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/marketplace-heroes. Two badge sizes included. Can we lock variant A for the main listing?
Olivia (Legal): StratusNode sent logo terms with 3 constraints: no modification, must use white background, and include trademark line on partner page. We need to confirm our CMS can render that.
StratusBot: Marketplace listing draft created: https://marketplace.redwood.com/drafts/stratusnode-edgeworks. Reviewers assigned: Elena, Lucy, Olivia.
Elena (Marketing): I reviewed the draft. Need customer microcase (one-paragraph) and a short exec quote. Temp placeholders are in. Also want localized CTA for ES and JA before we flip live.
Lucy (Partnerships): OK owners: SKU alias=Mark, Alias migration=Vikram, Webhook docs=Maya + Devex, Hero lock=Kasia, Logos/legal=Olivia, Locale microcopy=Elena. Target deadline: 2026-04-01 12:00Z. Any blockers?
Vikram (Engineering): Alias migration pushed to staging. Will monitor for 1h and then promote to canary. Also pushed a fix for health-check to backoff retries in ap-south.
Maya (EdgeWorks SI): I'll update integration guide with tenant_id and add a backwards-compatible sample. Will upload before EOD.
Kasia (Design): Variant A locked and exported to CMS. White-background single badge added per legal constraint.
Olivia (Legal): Noted. I'll attach the trademark line to the partner card copy and approve logo rendering. Sending signed acknowledgement to StratusNode.
Elena (Marketing): Localization: ES and JA microcopy requested. @Kasia can you send final strings to vendor? I can coordinate QA.
Lucy (Partnerships): Press embargo proposed: 2026-04-03T09:00:00Z UTC. If all green by 2026-04-02 18:00Z we keep that.
StratusBot: Embargo calendar invite created for 2026-04-03T09:00:00Z UTC.
Mark (Product): One more ask: telemetry event for marketplace installs needs `source=marketplace_stratusnode` tag. Can Eng add?
Vikram (Engineering): Will add telemetry tag in the install flow. ETA 3h.
Maya (EdgeWorks SI): Quick ask to Partnerships: can we schedule a 30m go/no-go call 2026-04-02 16:00Z to confirm everything?
Lucy (Partnerships): Yes, booked. I'll send invite.
Elena (Marketing): Mini checklist (post here when done):
- SKU alias created and promoted
- Webhook sample includes tenant_id
- Hero/Banner locked in CMS
- Logo legal ack + trademark line added
- Telemetry tag on installs
- ES/JA microcopy uploaded
- Staging health-checks stable for 2h
Lucy (Partnerships): I'll monitor and close thread when all checks are marked. Quick updates only, please.
